require-no-change.description: Requires the Git working tree to remain unchanged.
require-no-change.shell: git rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null && status=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) && test -z "$status"

require-more-deletions.description: Requires the tracked Git diff to contain more deletions than additions.
require-more-deletions.shell: changes=$(git diff --numstat HEAD --) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$changes" | awk 'NF==0 { next } $1 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ { invalid=1; next } { additions += $1; deletions += $2 } END { exit invalid || additions >= deletions }'

diff-max-10-lines.description: Blocks tracked Git changes exceeding 10 added and deleted lines.
diff-max-10-lines.shell: changes=$(git diff --numstat HEAD --) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$changes" | awk 'NF==0 { next } $1 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ || $2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ { invalid=1; next } { lines += $1 + $2 } END { exit invalid || lines > 10 }'
